ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: With the emergence and proliferation of social media such as Twitter, Instagram, and Reddit, we are facing a sea change-- with a magnitude much like the Web revolution two decades ago-- in not only how people express themselves and communicate, but also how we can listen to the world. With their ubiquitous popularity, while social networks have connected people, these social media spread their voices, and thus thoughts and information propagate in a speed and scale unseen before-- allowing for our listening to the world with algorithms, at not only a large scale, but also a high precision. This course will study advanced social analytic techniques for discovering and profiling the online social universe.
